question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

Bearing no name
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e. **"Anonymous."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Anonymous" **refers to something or someone that is not identified by name; it bears no name.(अनाम)
 
• It's often used when the creator or contributor of a work or comment prefers to stay unknown or unidentified.

Therefore, the** correct answer **is:** 'Anonymous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain all the given words:
 
 
• **"Namesake"** is a person or thing that has the same name as another.(नामी)
 
• "**Anomaly" **means something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected. (विषमता)
 
• **"Pseudonym"** is a fictitious name, especially one used by an author.(उपनाम)
